assets.title: Static Bypass Floral Stem Snips
assets.description: Original low-poly bypass floral stem snips with two curved blades in genuinely offset planes, two separate padded handles, two bored hubs, a fixed pin and positive-area bearing seats. Four upper-half meshes share one named editable pivot. Default near-closed pose retains a visible blade gap; a second fixed open pose at -40 degrees is verified by actual imported-world vertex transformations, mesh collision checks and bore/seat evidence. Original unmodified flower stem fits only the tested open alignment. No severing, continuous cutting sweep, spring action, force, gripping, load or safety certification.
